en.title: First Solo Trip to China: Build a Route You Can Recover
en.headline: A First Solo China Route That Still Works When One Thing Goes Wrong
en.description: Build a first solo China trip around recoverable bases, clean transfers, payment fallbacks and a protected departure day—not bravado or a packed checklist.

zh.title: 第一次独自去中国：设计一条出错也能恢复的路线
zh.headline: 第一次独自去中国，路线要经得起一个环节出错
zh.description: 用可恢复的城市基地、简单转场、支付备份和受保护的离境日规划独自中国行，不靠硬撑或塞满清单。
